notOnlyAccounting.title: Not just accounting — fast control of the situation
notOnlyAccounting.text: Rendlify first helps you understand what's happening with the property right now, and only then lets you manage the data in more depth. This matters most for owners and managers who need a clear answer: where's the money, where's the debt, where's the deviation, and what needs attention.

items.q: What kind of properties is Rendlify suited for?
items.a: Rendlify is suited for trading houses, markets, galleries and other properties where it's important to quickly see the situation across pavilions, tenants, payments and income.

items.q: Is this an accounting system or a property control system?
items.a: Both. But the main use case is fast, clear real-time control of the property's situation: who has paid, where there's debt, which expenses have already been recorded, and what the overall summary looks like.

items.q: Can payments be split across several channels?
items.a: Yes. The system supports non-cash payments, cash register 1 and cash register 2.
Yes. You can separately configure permissions to view, create, edit and delete data for different employees.
